body.en:
1. Exponential Relationship \( y = ab^x \):
Take natural logs of both sides: \( \ln y = \ln(a \cdot b^x) = \ln a + x \ln b \).
In \( Y = mX + c \) form: \( Y = \ln y \), \( X = x \), gradient \( m = \ln b \implies b = e^m \), and intercept \( c = \ln a \implies a = e^c \).

2. Power Relationship \( y = Ax^n \):
\( \ln y = \ln A + n \ln x \).
Here: \( Y = \ln y \), \( X = \ln x \), gradient \( m = n \), and intercept \( c = \ln A \implies A = e^c \).

label.en: Worked Example 3.A — Linear Law Model Fitting

body.en:
Variables \( x \) and \( y \) are related by \( y = ab^x \). A plot of \( \ln y \) against \( x \) produces a straight line passing through \( (2, 3.4) \) and \( (6, 5.8) \). Find the values of \( a \) and \( b \) to 3 significant figures.

Solution:
Gradient \( m = \frac{5.8 - 3.4}{6 - 2} = \frac{2.4}{4} = 0.6 \).
Since \( m = \ln b \implies \ln b = 0.6 \implies b = e^{0.6} \approx 1.82 \).
Equation of line: \( Y - 3.4 = 0.6(X - 2) \implies Y = 0.6X + 2.2 \).
The vertical intercept is \( c = 2.2 \).
Since \( c = \ln a \implies a = e^{2.2} \approx 9.03 \).
Answer: \( a \approx 9.03, \, b \approx 1.82 \).

label.en: Worked Example B — Algebraic Structure & Vieta's Root Relations
label.ar: مثال محلول B — البنية الجبرية وعلاقات الجذور

body.en:
Solve the quadratic equation \( x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0 \) and verify the sum and product of its roots.

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Factor into binomials: \( (x - 3)(x - 6) = 0 \implies x = 3 \text{ or } x = 6 \).
  2. Check Vieta's formulas: sum \( = 3 + 6 = \mathbf{9} \) and product \( = (3)(6) = \mathbf{18} \).
body.ar:
حل المعادلة التربيعية \( x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0 \) وتحقق من مجموع وحاصل ضرب الجذرين.

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. التحليل إلى عوامل: \( (x - 3)(x - 6) = 0 \implies x = 3 \text{ أو } x = 6 \).
  2. المجموع \( = \mathbf{9} \) وحاصل الضرب \( = \mathbf{18} \).

question.en: [Logarithms, Exponentials & Straight-Line Reduction · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Logarithms, Exponentials & Straight-Line Reduction · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).
